card.name: G in eGFR and N in sample counts
card.fires_on: The capital G in the abbreviation eGFR (estimated glomerular filtration rate) in renal dosing text. Also the capital N after "n<" in lab-result tables of patient counts.

modes.label: G inside eGFR
modes.description: The letter G after the e in eGFR, right before a kidney function threshold in mL/min.
modes.example: for patients with severe renal impairment (e<<G>>FR < 30 mL/min)

modes.label: N in patient counts
modes.description: The capital N in n/N patient counts in lab-value tables.

card.plain: It fires on the G in eGFR, the kidney function measure, and on N in patient counts in trial tables.
